options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the target user role.

options.name: properties
options.description: Dictionary with desired properties for the user role. Used for O(state=present); ignored for O(state=absent|facts). Dictionary key is the property name with underscores instead of hyphens, and dictionary value is the property value in YAML syntax. Integer properties may also be provided as decimal strings. The possible input properties in this dictionary are the properties defined as writeable in the data model for user role resources (where the property names contain underscores instead of hyph

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state for the HMC user role. All states are fully idempotent within the limits of the properties that can be changed: * V(absent): Ensures that the user role does not exist. * V(present): Ensures that the user role exists and has the specified properties. * V(facts): Returns the user role properties.
